source_architecture_summary: A humanities debate contrasts positions through practitioner viewpoints, illustrative cases, and a qualified account of how cultural mediation changes an audience's experience.
feasibility_notes: Blueprint A examines museum replicas and touch; Blueprint B examines reconstructed historic buildings. Both replace film dubbing, language substitution, directors, actors, and source examples.
